# {{ site.author.name }}, narrative designer and game writer

> {{ site.description | strip }}

{{ site.author.name }} is a narrative designer and game writer based in Houston, Texas, with 6+ years of experience on PC, console and mobile games. She writes quests, branching dialogue, characters, lore and cinematic scripts, and implements narrative content in Unity, Unreal, articy:draft and Twine. She is open to full-time roles (on-site or hybrid in Houston, or remote), long-term contracts and freelance work. All writing on this site is her own and is not AI-generated.
